title: Among Us Round Start
blurb: Ten players drop into the ship and the game quietly decides who is about to lie to everyone. The opening cue plays over the role reveal, the half-second where you find out whether the next four minutes are a chore simulator or a murder spree. It carries a specific dread if you drew Impostor and have to immediately act normal in front of people who know you well. Short, and quietly loaded. Useful whenever a group is about to start something and nobody has admitted their intentions yet.
origin: The round-start cue from Among Us.
